blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 177 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 9, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & MRNA lead 177 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 35 Canadian and 142 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 9, 2026) found 177 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 35 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 19 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +97% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 7 names.

In the U.S., 142 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 63 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +438% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 39 names.
